targets.quote: It is a new growth strategy that aims to transform the EU into a fair and prosperous society, with a modern, resource-efficient and competitive economy where there are no net emissions of greenhouse gases in 2050 and where economic growth is decoupled from resource use.
targets.article: 1. Introduction - turning an urgent challenge into a unique opportunity
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: This will enshrine the 2050 climate neutrality objective in legislation.
targets.article: 2.1.1 Increasing the EU’s climate ambition for 2030 and 2050
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: By summer 2020, the Commission will present an impact assessed plan to increase the EU’s greenhouse gas emission reductions target for 2030 to at least 50% and towards 55% compared with 1990 levels in a responsible way.
targets.article: 2.1.1 Increasing the EU’s climate ambition for 2030 and 2050
targets.label: target

targets.quote: The Commission will develop requirements to ensure that all packaging in the EU market is reusable or recyclable in an economically viable manner by 2030, will develop a regulatory framework for biodegradable and bio-based plastics, and will implement measures on single use plastics.
targets.article: 2.1.3 Mobilising industry for a clean and circular economy
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: As an example, the Commission will support clean steel breakthrough technologies leading to a zero-carbon steel making process by 2030 and will explore whether part of the funding being liquidated under the European Coal and Steel Community can be used.
targets.article: 2.1.3 Mobilising industry for a clean and circular economy
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: To achieve climate neutrality, a 90% reduction in transport emissions is needed by 2050.
targets.article: 2.1.5 Accelerating the shift to sustainable and smart mobility
targets.label: target

targets.quote: By 2025, about 1 million public recharging and refuelling stations will be needed for the 13 million zero- and low-emission vehicles expected on European roads.
targets.article: 2.1.5 Accelerating the shift to sustainable and smart mobility
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: The Commission’s proposals for the common agricultural policy for 2021 to 2027 stipulate that at least 40% of the common agricultural policy’s overall budget and at least 30% of the Maritime Fisheries Fund would contribute to climate action.
targets.article: 2.1.6 From ‘Farm to Fork’: designing a fair, healthy and environmentally-friendly food system
targets.label: target
indicators: share of CAP budget contributing to climate action

targets.quote: The EU and its global partners need to halt biodiversity loss.
targets.article: 2.1.7 Preserving and restoring ecosystems and biodiversity
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: To address these interlinked challenges, the Commission will adopt in 2021 a zero pollution action plan for air, water and soil.
targets.article: 2.1.8 A zero pollution ambition for a toxic-free environment
targets.label: commitment
indicators: pollution from air, water and soil
